issues.title_en: Govt ‘concerned’ as Malawi’s 40-year Commonwealth Games medal drought continues
issues.summary: Ministry of Youth, Sports and Culture says it is concerned after Team Malawi completed its campaign at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow without winning a single medal. Before the Games, Sports Minister Alfred Gangata had urged the team to end a medal drought stretching back 40 years. issues.title_en: Guatemala issues red alert after active Fuego volcano erupts
issues.summary: Emergency services in Guatemala issued a red alert, the most severe warning, after the Fuego volcano – located less than 100 kilometres from its capital – erupted Monday morning. Hundreds of people living nearby evacuated their homes Tuesday as rivers of lava streamed down its slopes and ash rose some six kilometres into the sky.
